title: Absorbing completed recorder state
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean machine, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of the recording machine on input $x$. If $c$ is in the completed return state, then one machine step leaves the entire configuration unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $c$ of the recording machine on input $x$
The control state of $c$ is the completed return state
replaced: Every configuration of the recorder host whose control is the recorder's completed return is left entirely unchanged by one step, with the full retained input and header frame unchanged.
